subject: Post-call: locale pilot proposal + prompt bundle for Polaris Commerce
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marta Kozlowska <marta.kozlowska@polariscommerce.pl>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@polariscommerce.jp>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: locale pilot proposal + prompt bundle for Polaris Commerce

Hi Marta / Rajiv — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side.

What we heard
- Primary goals: higher-quality checkout copy & category SEO in PL/SE/FI for EU, and product description fluency for JA/KO in APAC.
- Risk: regressions on low-resource EU languages (Polish dialects, Finnish inflection) are the biggest blocker.
- Success criteria: locale-specific BLEU/chrF lift vs baseline testset, human acceptability >= 90% on sample prompts, latency <= 350ms p50 for interactive flows.

Redwood recommendation (short list)
- EU pilot (cheap + fast): rwd-7b-8k-quant with per-locale prompt templates and prefix-caching for checkout flows.
- EU high-quality variant: open-llama-13b-qlo with 8k context for batch generation on catalogue descriptions.
- APAC languages: rwd-13b-ft (Japanese/Korean fine-tuned variant) for better honorific handling.

Artifacts I attached / shared
- Prompt bundle: polaris_prompt_set_v1.csv (short templated examples for checkout/SEO/product)
- Locale benchmark sheet: locale-benchmarks-20270601.xlsx (sample metrics we ran on your seed prompts)
- Compact model recommendations: model_recs-compact.pdf
Links: full eval harness and raw scores -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_locale_benchmarks

Proposed next steps
1) Run a focused 2-week pilot on the rwd-7b-8k-quant with your top 2 languages (PL + JA) — Redwood will provide the prompt bundle, evaluation harness, and per-locale regression alerts.
2) We’ll run a lightweight human acceptability check (4 raters per locale) and return a rollup report + per-prompt failure cases.
3) Cost/throughput estimate for scaling to catalogue volumes (we’ll include burst policy options).

Can you confirm scope (PL + JA) and target pilot start date the week of June 14? If that looks good I’ll loop in our Solutions engineer (stephanie) for implementation details and a short kickoff doc.

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0178
https://redwood.ai
From: Marta Kozlowska <marta.kozlowska@polariscommerce.pl>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@polariscommerce.jp>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call: locale pilot proposal + prompt bundle for Polaris Commerce

Thanks Neha — very thorough. A few follow-ups from our side: 

1) Scope confirmation: PL + JA is fine for the pilot. We also want a lightweight Finnish checkbox (FI) for checkout prompts; if the 7b can cover PL+FI that would be ideal.
2) Regression concern: our localization team has seen hallucinations around measurements/currency conversions in PL -> we need guardrails for numeric fidelity and brand tone.
3) Benchmarks: can you provide per-locale precision/recall or chrF breakdowns and the raw sample outputs so our localization QA can run side-by-side tests?
4) Procurement: I’ll need an estimate for monthly committed capacity for the pilot (tokens/day) and a procurement contact for commercial terms (CCing our procurement lead below).

Rajiv — any APAC-specific constraints you want us to surface now?

Marta

--
Marta Kozlowska
Head of Localization | Polaris Commerce
marta.kozlowska@polariscommerce.pl
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marta Kozlowska <marta.kozlowska@polariscommerce.pl>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: locale pilot proposal + prompt bundle for Polaris Commerce

Marta — great questions. Looping in Marissa (sales engineering) and Jonas (applied ML) + Stephanie (solutions) to cover benchmarks, numeric fidelity checks, and procurement cadence. Answers below and actions.

Responses
- PL + FI with rwd-7b-8k-quant: yes, the model handled FI morphological forms in our internal tests when we used the inflection-aware prompt templates (see prompt set column "inflection_hint"). We’ll include FI as a 3rd language in the pilot at no extra setup cost.
- Numeric fidelity: we have two mitigations: (a) constrained decoding with numeric white-listing for price/currency tokens, and (b) post-response sanity checks (regex-based) that trigger a safe fallback response and log an evaluation failure. We’ll wire those into the pilot harness.
- Benchmarks and raw outputs: attached is locale-benchmarks-20270601.xlsx with per-locale chrF/BLEU and sample outputs; full CSV raw outputs are shared in the Drive link.
- Procurement estimate: for a 2-week pilot serving up to 10k interactions/day at nominal length (~60 avg tokens) estimate is ~1.5M tokens / month. We’ll provide two pricing options (on-demand vs reserved pilot commit).

Actions (owner in parentheses)
- Stephanie: prepare a short kickoff doc and implementation checklist (templates, API keys, webhook for candidate outputs) by Thu 6/3.
- Jonas: run targeted 48-hour stress tests focused on p50/p95 latency and attach brief notes about caching impact (complete Fri 6/4).
- Marissa: draft pilot SOW and a one-page commercial estimate for the token bands (draft by Fri 6/4).

I attached the prompt bundle (polaris_prompt_set_v1.csv) and model recs PDF. I’ll follow up with a short DocuSign link for the pilot SOW once Marissa has the numbers.

Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Marta Kozlowska <marta.kozlowska@polariscommerce.pl>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@polariscommerce.jp>, Procurement Team <procurement@polariscommerce.pl>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 15:26:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call: locale pilot proposal + prompt bundle for Polaris Commerce

Thanks — that all looks good. We’re aligned to start the pilot by Monday 2027-06-14. Procurement, please review the SOW when available; we expect a single-month pilot PO and a short NDA addendum for data handling.

Two quick asks before kickoff:
- Can Redwood provide an embargoed example report of a prior EU pilot (anonymized) so our legal/compliance team can understand data retention and logs?
- Please include a short checklist for our engineering team outlining required sandbox credentials and webhook endpoints.

Once we have the SOW and the pilot kickoff doc, I’ll confirm the PO owner and share terms. Looking forward to getting started.

Best — Marta
